Cloud Gateways Switching WiFi Physical Security Door Access Integrations More from UI Enjoy Peace of Mind With 24-Hour Professional Support Now available globally as an upgraded support tier. Easy Access to Paid Support Getting started with Professional Support is straightforward. Simply visit the UniFi Site Manager. Get Started in 3 Easy Steps 1 or 3 Year Pricing Plans Activate in Site Manager 1 Activate in the Site Manager at unifi.ui.com 2 Meet Your Dedicated UniFi Professional via 1-on-1 Video Call (Optional) 3 Receive Priority Support by Phone, Video Call, and Email Available for Cloud Gateways. Coming soon for other deployments. Go to Site Manager Expertise at Your Fingertips Our dedicated team of UniFi Engineers, stationed in the US and Europe, is highly trained and qualified to assist with any queries or issues you might encounter. Hear From Our Satisfied Clients My Support Engineer was awesome to work with. Great troubleshooting skills and was very helpful the entire process! UniFi Site Support provides priority phone support to a single physical site managed with a UniFi Cloud Gateway or other UniFi Network deployment. We will support all UniFi devices at that physical site. Site Support will be available for other types of UniFi site deployments in the future. If you have non-Network devices such as Physical Security devices (UniFi Protect / Access), they are included in the same site-level license with your Network devices, even if they are managed by a UNVR at the same site. How do I subscribe to Site Support? Visit the UniFi Site Manager at unifi.ui.com and locate your desired site. Then, click the button at the bottom-right of the site’s tile and follow the instructions to subscribe to Site Support. When and how is Site Support available? Phone support is available round-the-clock with a 24x7 plan, or 9am-5pm with a Business Hours plan. After registering, you will receive an email with instructions for multiple convenient options to schedule a call with Site Support. Where is Site Support available? Site Support is available globally with limited exceptions. If you have any questions, please email site.support.inquiries@ui.com . In what languages is Site Support available? Currently, English only.
